#!/bin/sh
# Nightly log backup. Bundles logs/ into a tarball and copies it to the destination.
set -eu

# The destination can be supplied as the first argument or in BACKUP_DEST.
# Use BACKUP_DEST in cron environments; an existing DEST env var is also honored.
DEST="${DEST:-${BACKUP_DEST:-}}"
if [ "$#" -ge 1 ]; then
    DEST="$1"
fi

if [ -z "$DEST" ]; then
    echo "backup destination not set; pass it as an argument or set BACKUP_DEST" >&2
    exit 2
fi

STAMP=$(date +%Y%m%d)
BUNDLE="logs-$STAMP.tar.gz"

tar -czf "$BUNDLE" logs/

# Copy to a local path or directory, or to a remote host via scp for host:path.
if [ -d "$DEST" ] || [ -f "$DEST" ]; then
    cp "$BUNDLE" "$DEST"
else
    case "$DEST" in
        *:*)
            scp -q "$BUNDLE" "$DEST"
            ;;
        *)
            cp "$BUNDLE" "$DEST"
            ;;
    esac
fi

echo "wrote $BUNDLE and copied it to $DEST"
